Title: A four-electrode low frequency impedance spectroscopy measurement system using the AD5933 measurement chip
Authors: C. Margo; J. Katrib; M. Nadi; A. Rouane
Other_EIS_Features: Geometric cell factor K_cell = 130 m^-1
Main_EIS_Finding: Tetrapolar configuration completely eliminates electrode-electrolyte interface impedance artifacts present in bipolar mode; phase remains near 0 deg at low frequencies
Numerical_Ranges: Modulus error < 1.5% at 4 kHz; Phase error < 0.2 deg at 4 kHz; conductivity 0.14 - 1.2 S/m
Important_Limitations: Evaluated on ionic solutions not whole food tissue; upper frequency limited to 100 kHz by AD5933

Title: Electrical Impedance Spectroscopy for Quality Assessment of Meat and Fish: A Review on Basic Principles Measurement Methods and Recent Advances
Authors: X. Zhao; H. Zhuang; S.-C. Yoon; Y. Dong; W. Wang; W. Zhao
Other_EIS_Features: Cole-Cole parameters (R0; Rinf; alpha; fc); Py-parameter; equivalent circuits
Main_EIS_Finding: EIS non-destructively monitors cell membrane lysis and post-mortem biochemical changes; tetrapolar needle configuration reduces contact impedance
Numerical_Ranges: Impedance drops 30-60% during post-mortem storage; Py decays toward 0
Correlation: R^2 > 0.70-0.90 with TVB-N/TVC across reviewed studies
Important_Limitations: Different electrode dimensions and biological anisotropy prevent direct numerical comparison across papers

Title: Estimating freshness of carp based on EIS morphological characteristic
Authors: J. Sun; R.-B. Zhang; Y.-C. Zhang; G.-X. Li; Q.-F. Liang
Electrode_Material: Platinum wires (1 mm dia; 15 mm length)
Other_EIS_Features: Characteristic peak frequencies; curvature of Nyquist plot; equivalent circuit parameters
Main_EIS_Finding: EIS morphological characteristics eliminate individual biological baseline discrepancies; impedance arc shrinks systematically during storage
Numerical_Ranges: Fresh |Z| at 1 kHz ~ 1.2-1.8 kOhm decaying to 0.4-0.6 kOhm at day 7 (setup-specific)
Important_Limitations: Bipolar needle probe prone to contact impedance at lowest frequencies; 4°C only

Title: Classifying fish freshness according to the relationship between EIS parameters and spoilage stages
Authors: J. Sun; R.-B. Zhang; Y.-C. Zhang; Q. Liang; G.-H. Li; N. Yang; P. Xu; J.-J. Guo
Other_EIS_Features: Peak of Extremum Morphological Characteristic (PEMC); R0; Rinf; CPE
Main_EIS_Finding: Identified 3 distinct spoilage stages (Fresh: 0-3 d; Secondary fresh: 4-5 d; Spoiled: 6-8 d) mapping to Cole-Cole parameters and impedance magnitude drop
Numerical_Ranges: R0 drops from ~1.5 kOhm to ~0.5 kOhm; TVB-N rises from 8.2 to 28.4 mg/100g
Correlation: R^2 = 0.86 with TVB-N; R^2 = 0.82 with TVC
Important_Limitations: Absolute resistance values depend strictly on 10 mm needle spacing and 10 mm insertion depth

Title: A Fusion Parameter Method for Classifying Freshness of Fish Based on Electrochemical Impedance Spectroscopy
Authors: J. Sun; Y. Liu; G. Wu; Y. Zhang; R. Zhang; X. Li
Electrode_Material: Platinum needles (1 mm dia; 15 mm length)
Other_EIS_Features: Fusion parameters: equivalent circuit R_e; R_i; CPE-T; CPE-P combined with statistical features
Main_EIS_Finding: Parameter fusion of Cole parameters outperforms single-frequency impedance for classifying freshness stages
Numerical_Ranges: R_e decreases by 64% over storage; TVB-N threshold 20 mg/100g crossed on Day 5
Important_Limitations: Probe requires physical insertion; tested exclusively at constant 4°C

Title: Use of impedance spectroscopy for predicting freshness of sea bream (Sparus aurata)
Authors: E. Perez-Esteve; A. Fuentes; R. Masot; I. Martinez-Manez; J. M. Barat
Other_EIS_Features: Modulus and phase at specific frequencies (100 Hz; 1 kHz; 10 kHz; 100 kHz)
Ground_Truth_Method: Conway microdiffusion; glass pH probe; oven drying
Main_EIS_Finding: Impedance modulus at low frequency dropped significantly during storage; PLS model accurately predicted TVB-N across 15 days
Numerical_Ranges: TVB-N increased from 14.2 to 38.5 mg/100g; |Z| at 1 kHz dropped by >50%
Important_Limitations: Inter-batch variability in fat content affected baseline impedance values

Title: Differentiation between fresh and frozen-thawed sea bream (Sparus aurata) using impedance spectroscopy techniques
Authors: A. Fuentes; R. Masot; I. Fernandez-Segovia; J. M. Barat; I. Martinez-Manez
Other_EIS_Features: Modulus and phase at 10 kHz; Nyquist arc radius
Main_EIS_Finding: Freezing and thawing destroys cell membranes; phase angle at 10 kHz is strongly sensitive to membrane rupture
Numerical_Ranges: Fresh phase at 10 kHz ~ -15 deg vs frozen-thawed phase ~ -3 deg
Important_Limitations: Focuses on fresh vs frozen distinction rather than continuous daily spoilage kinetics

Title: Py - a parameter for meat quality
Authors: U. Pliquett; M. Altmann; F. Pliquett; L. Schoberlein
Other_EIS_Features: Py parameter: Py = (|Z_lf| - |Z_hf|) / |Z_hf| or (R0 - Rinf) / Rinf
Ground_Truth_Method: Filter paper press method; pH meter
Main_EIS_Finding: Introduced Py-parameter as a normalized metric for cell membrane volume fraction; Py cancels geometric cell constant
Numerical_Ranges: Py drops from > 1.8 in intact muscle to < 0.2 in PSE / damaged tissue
Important_Limitations: Pork suffers from acute post-mortem PSE/DFD glycolytic defects that confound spoilage with post-slaughter stress

Title: A Technique for Nonmicrobial Freshness Evaluation of Broiler Breast Meat Using a Handheld Electrical Impedance Meter
Authors: H. Shinji; C. Yamamoto; M. Otake; S. Okabe; M. Otsuka
Other_EIS_Features: Impedance Ratio: R_imp = |Z(2 kHz)| / |Z(100 kHz)|
Main_EIS_Finding: Impedance ratio decreased monotonically from Day 0 to Day 10 and showed strong negative correlation with K-value
Numerical_Ranges: R_imp decreased from 2.45 +/- 0.15 (Day 0) to 1.15 +/- 0.08 (Day 10); K-value rose from 12% to 68%
Important_Limitations: Measured non-microbial ATP decay; surface vs deep muscle spoilage not separated

Title: Beef meat electrical impedance spectroscopy and anisotropy sensing for non-invasive early assessment of meat ageing
Authors: J.-P. Damez; S. Clerjon; S. Abouelkaram; J. Lepetit
Other_EIS_Features: Anisotropy index: Z_transverse / Z_longitudinal; Cole-Cole arc parameters
Freshness_Ground_Truth: Aging tenderness (Warner-Bratzler shear force); sarcomere length
Main_EIS_Finding: Muscle fiber anisotropy causes 200-300% variation in raw impedance depending on orientation relative to fibers
Numerical_Ranges: Longitudinal |Z| ~ 400 Ohm vs Transverse |Z| ~ 1100 Ohm at 1 kHz
Important_Limitations: Extreme structural anisotropy makes unaligned probe measurements completely unrepeatable for freshness assessment

Title: Utilization of Electrical Impedance Spectroscopy and Image Classification for Non-Invasive Early Assessment of Meat Freshness
Authors: P. S. Liu; Y. H. Chen; C. Y. Lin; T. W. Huang
Other_EIS_Features: Multi-frequency impedance spectrum fused with RGB image color features
Freshness_Ground_Truth: Aerobic Plate Count (APC / TVC); Total Volatile Basic Nitrogen
Main_EIS_Finding: EIS combined with computer vision significantly improved beef freshness classification under temperature abuse
Numerical_Ranges: APC crossed 6.0 log CFU/g threshold on Day 3 at 4°C vs Day 1 at 25°C;|Z| dropped 45%
Important_Limitations: Requires camera integration; probe insertion causes localized tissue damage

Title: Effect of freezing on electrical properties and quality of thawed chicken breast meat
Authors: B. Wang; H. Zhuang; D. W. Lawrence; S. C. Yoon; W. Wang
Other_EIS_Features: Impedance change ratio (Q-value); R0; Rinf; alpha; relaxation time tau
Main_EIS_Finding: Freezing duration significantly reduced low-frequency impedance and increased intracellular electrolyte release
Numerical_Ranges: Q-value decreased by 52% after prolonged storage; R0 dropped from 1850 Ohm to 820 Ohm
Important_Limitations: Plate electrode requires destructive cutting of meat to fit cylindrical cell; high contact resistance

Title: Bioimpedance Analysis of Tilapia Freshness and Spoilage Dynamics during Chilled Storage
Authors: Y. Liang; J. Zhang; M. Li; C. Zhao; W. Wang
Other_EIS_Features: Dual-frequency ratio (5 kHz / 100 kHz); Phase angle at 20 kHz; Cole-Cole R_e
Main_EIS_Finding: 4-electrode needle probe tracks fish freshness with high repeatability; cell membrane degradation directly matches TVB-N threshold
Numerical_Ranges: TVB-N reached 20 mg/100g on Day 6; ratio dropped from 2.30 to 1.10; phase dropped from -18 deg to -3 deg
Important_Limitations: Insertion depth variation affects raw modulus; requires standardized mechanical jig

Title: Electrical impedance estimation for apple fruit tissues during storage using Cole-Cole plots
Authors: U. Rehman; D. D. Simms; M. Bilawal; M. A. Khan
Other_EIS_Features: Cole-Cole parameters (R0; Rinf; alpha); cell membrane capacitance Cm
Freshness_Ground_Truth: Firmness; Soluble Solids Content (Brix); Titratable Acidity
Main_EIS_Finding: Storage softening correlates with decrease in cell wall resistance and membrane capacitance
Numerical_Ranges: R0 dropped from 45 kOhm to 18 kOhm over 60 days; Firmness dropped from 65 N to 38 N
Important_Limitations: Apples take 30-60 days to soften; fruit freshness is physiological senescence rather than microbial spoilage

Title: Application of fuzzy model for the shelf-life determination of whole sea bass (Dicentrarchus labrax) under refrigerated temperatures
Authors: I. Y. Genc
Other_EIS_Features: Fuzzy inference system using microbiological bacterial counts to predict sensory shelf life
Freshness_Ground_Truth: Sensory Quality Index Method (QIM); Total Aerobic Bacteria (TMAB/TPAB)
Main_EIS_Finding: Mamdani fuzzy inference system with centroid defuzzification accurately modeled fish shelf life (8 days)
Numerical_Ranges: Microbial counts rose from 2.8 to 7.8 log CFU/g; QIM reached rejection at Day 8
Correlation: R^2 = 0.96 between fuzzy model and sensory score
Prediction_Method: Mamdani Fuzzy Logic (12 rules; Triangular MFs)
Important_Limitations: Modeled shelf-life from offline microbiology counts; does not incorporate real-time EIS sensor inputs

Title: Effect of composition on the electrical conductance of milk
Authors: M. F. Mabrook; M. C. Petty
Other_EIS_Features: Electrolytic conductivity sigma; bulk admittance
Main_EIS_Finding: Bacterial lactic fermentation causes progressive release of free ions from colloidal calcium phosphate; conductivity surges linearly with acidity
Numerical_Ranges: Fresh milk conductivity ~ 4.5 - 5.5 mS/cm increasing to > 7.5 mS/cm during souring
Important_Limitations: Liquid measurement requires fixed cell constant K_cell; needle insertion without fixed spacer causes geometric error

Title: Bioimpedance of cow milk during bacterial acidification and spoilage
Authors: P. Bertemes-Filho; V. C. Valicheski; M. Pereira; A. S. Paterno
Other_EIS_Features: Complex admittance Y*; loss factor tan delta; phase angle
Main_EIS_Finding: Tetrapolar bioimpedance successfully eliminates electrode polarization in milk; electrical admittance sharply differentiates fresh milk (pH 6.6) from spoiled curdling milk (pH < 5.2)
Numerical_Ranges: Admittance magnitude increased by 48% as pH dropped below 5.0
Important_Limitations: Temperature strongly influences ionic mobility (+2.0%/°C)

Title: Real-time monitoring of meat and fish freshness using on-package ammonia sensor
Authors: B. Kuswandi; Jayus; T. S. Larasati; A. Abdullah; L. Y. Heng
Other_EIS_Features: Headspace NH3 concentration (ppm); volatile basic amine optical response
Main_EIS_Finding: Volatile ammonia gas correlates directly with TVB-N and detects surface bacterial proliferation before deep tissue autolysis
Numerical_Ranges: Fresh headspace NH3 < 5 ppm; spoiled NH3 > 25 - 40 ppm; TVB-N > 20 mg/100g
Correlation: R^2 = 0.92 with TVB-N; R^2 = 0.89 with TVC
Important_Limitations: Requires sealed or enclosed headspace dome; open air draft dilutes ammonia reading

Title: Coagulation process of soymilk characterized by electrical impedance spectroscopy
Authors: X. Li; K. Toyoda; I. Ihara
Other_EIS_Features: Impedance modulus |Z|; phase angle theta; conductivity
Freshness_Ground_Truth: Gel strength; moisture content; microbial liquefaction
Ground_Truth_Method: Texture analyzer; oven drying; plate count
Main_EIS_Finding: EIS is effective for monitoring soy protein network formation and degradation; 10 kHz is optimal sensitivity node for gel tortuosity
Numerical_Ranges: Impedance ratio falls by > 40% upon protein matrix degradation and syneresis
Important_Limitations: Tofu matrix has high moisture (80-85%); microbial spoilage causes syneresis and slime formation

Title: Tempe fermentation innovation and functionality: update into the third millennium
Authors: M. J. R. Nout; J. L. Kiers
Other_EIS_Features: Free amino acids; ammonia concentration; mycelial density
Main_EIS_Finding: Rhizopus oligosporus mycelia bind cotyledons into a coherent cake; over-fermentation produces rapid proteolysis and ammonia surge
Numerical_Ranges: Fresh tempe NH3 < 5 ppm; over-fermented tempe busuk NH3 > 20 - 50 ppm
Correlation: r = 0.93 between ammonia and sensory rejection
Important_Limitations: Tempe requires distinction between peak fermentation (safe) and proteolytic spoilage (ammoniacal off-odor)
